text.en:
Section 2 of P.D. No. 1183 a amended by section 2 of P.D. 1205 is hereby further amended by
adding a new paragraph after paragraph "1" thereof which shall read as follows:
"m) Persons whose travel is provided for funded by foreign governments with which the Philippine
Government maintains diplomatic relations."

All acts, decrees, executive orders, administrative orders rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with the provision of this Decree are repealed or modified accordingly.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
